bio.text: According to her campaign website, Saira Draper is the Democratic candidate for Georgia State Senate District 44 and has served in the Georgia State House.
The website says Draper was raised in Georgia and earned a degree from Georgia Tech and a law degree from Georgetown.
It says she was a civil rights attorney at the Southern Poverty Law Center and, in 2020, led voting rights efforts for the Biden, Warnock and Ossoff campaigns.
